announcements.headline: 2nd quarter results
announcements.insight: As a UK-listed vehicle for an Indian state-owned enterprise, GAID's quarterly results are largely driven by domestic regulatory frameworks and gas pricing policies in India rather than UK market dynamics, rendering them immaterial to the London equity landscape.
